title: Dilation pull-back of a test form: δ_λ^#ω is a test form and (δ_λ^#ω)(x) = λ^k ω(λx)
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ and λ ∈ ℝ with λ ≠ 0, and let ω ∈ TestFormOn univ k, i.e. a C^∞ compactly supported k-form on ℝ^P = Euclid P. Write L := λ·id = lam • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid P) and δ_λ^#ω := affinePullbackForm L 0 ω, the pull-back of ω along δ_λ(x) = λx: (δ_λ^#ω)(x) = (ω(0 + Lx)).compContinuousLinearMap L, the k-covector (v_1, …, v_k) ↦ ω(λx)(λv_1, …, λv_k). Then some test form η ∈ TestFormOn univ k has underlying differential form δ_λ^#ω, and η(x) = λ^k · ω(λx) as k-covectors for every x ∈ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (lam : ℝ), lam ≠ 0 → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, ∃ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) = affinePullbackForm (lam • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid P)) 0 (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) ∧ ∀ x : Euclid P, (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x = lam ^ k • (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) (lam • x)
